description: What this server knows and which tool reads it: every kind of fact (person, membership, roster, commitfest entry, feature, decision, position, ...) with attributes, types, cardinality, docs and counts, and which kinds refer to which; the design-history graph's relations (thread DISCUSSES feature, decision DECIDES feature, person HOLDS position ABOUT feature, ...), sources (git, commitfest, rule, operator, model) and confidence (shown from 0.8, "probably" from 0.5, hidden below; models at most 0.9); the tables tools read; what is loaded (commits, tags, entries). Call it first to learn what can be asked. Same as GET /api/v2/ontology.
name: get_ontology
